registryEntry.label: Create Network Watcher
registryEntry.get_command: Get-AzNetworkWatcher | Where-Object {$_.Location -eq '{location}'} | Select-Object Name, Location, ResourceGroupName, ProvisioningState | ConvertTo-Json
registryEntry.set_command: $existing = Get-AzNetworkWatcher | Where-Object {$_.Location -eq '{location}'}; if (-not $existing) { New-AzNetworkWatcher -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name 'nw-{location}' -Location '{location}' } else { Write-Output "Network Watcher already exists in $($existing.ResourceGroupName) - no action needed" }
evidence_commands: Get-AzNetworkWatcher | Where-Object {$_.Location -eq '{location}'} | Select-Object Name, Location, ResourceGroupName, ProvisioningState | ConvertTo-Json
